body:
Self-caused: cmd/bootstrap ran against a throwaway SQLite DB but IDUNA_ROOT still pointed at the real checkout, overwriting var/agent-secrets.env for all 20 real agents. Real production DB untouched. Founder approved full rotation (cmd/bootstrap -rotate) + restart of 5 affected live systemd consumers (REDGARDEN x2, redgarden-stable, ECOWAR, GFD MUD), each with its own per-repo secret copy updated first. Verified live via a real /api/v1/auth/agent call and post-restart logs showing zero auth errors. Memory saved: throwaway_instance_full_isolation.md.

⚓ ☃
title: incident: agent-secrets.env corrupted by throwaway-instance env leak, resolved via rotation + consumer restart
